analysis.overall: You spent 82% of your day in range despite a stubborn low yesterday afternoon and a morning drift above 200 mg/dL. Small automated corrections kept your overnight steady and helped bring highs down fairly quickly.

events.title: Afternoon low & rebound
events.description: Glucose hovered below target for over an hour, hitting 57 mg/dL before a 30g carb treatment sent levels up to 193 mg/dL.

events.title: Evening smooth landing
events.description: After an early evening rise to 187 mg/dL, minor corrections helped bring glucose down gently to a stable 94 mg/dL.

events.title: Morning climb to 213 mg/dL
events.description: Glucose drifted up steadily after 7:30 AM to the peak of the day before a correction bolus turned the trend back downward.

events.title: Lunch meal bolus
events.description: Dosing for a 40g lunch as glucose dropped to 80 mg/dL stopped the fall and started a steady climb back into range.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on the morning drift after 7:30 AM — stepping in earlier might prevent crossing over 200 mg/dL.
